_comment: The innovations of this age. 'cost' is the innovation points it takes to research (times this age's 'innovation_cost_multiplier' in age.json, normally 1). 'interface': the branch of government that may research it (data/rules/interfaces.json). 'prerequisites' must come from this age or an earlier one.

innovations.name: Fire
innovations.description: Control of fire for warmth and cooking.

innovations.name: Language
innovations.description: Spoken communication for coordination.

innovations.name: Tribalism
innovations.description: Organized kinship groups for social structure.

innovations.name: Hierarchy
innovations.description: Structured social ranks for authority.

innovations.name: Diplomacy
innovations.description: Negotiation with external groups.

innovations.name: Chieftainship
innovations.description: The idea of a lasting, formal leader.

innovations.name: Symbolism
innovations.description: Basic understanding of symbols.

innovations.name: Oral History
innovations.description: Memorization of important events and judgments.

innovations.name: Sacred Storytelling
innovations.description: Retelling of sacred history and beliefs.

innovations.name: Oral Codes
innovations.description: Memorization and retelling of the group's rules.

innovations.name: Oral Law
innovations.description: Breaking the group's rules comes with consequences.

innovations.name: Dispute Resolution
innovations.description: A recognized way of settling conflicts.

innovations.name: Punishment
innovations.description: Ability to impose negative consequences.

innovations.name: Ostracism
innovations.description: Ability to cast a member out of the group.

innovations.name: Tribal Arbitration
innovations.description: Mediation by the whole group.

innovations.name: Trial by Elder Council
innovations.description: Judgment by a group of elders.

innovations.name: Barter System
innovations.description: Person-to-person trading.

innovations.name: Gardens on the Move
innovations.description: Spreading seeds along seasonal routes.

innovations.name: Toolmaking
innovations.description: Sharpening wood into simple tools: wooden hand axes, knives and spears. Opens the Toolmaker.

innovations.name: Hunting
innovations.description: Tracking and taking game with spears. Opens the Hunter (who needs a spear).

innovations.name: Fishing
innovations.description: Spearing fish in the shallows. Opens the Fisher and the fishing spear.

innovations.name: Tracking
innovations.description: Reading the land for signs of game, water and stone. Opens the Scout.

innovations.name: Herbalism
innovations.description: Knowing which plants heal. Opens the Healer and poultices.

innovations.name: Archery
innovations.description: Bows and wooden arrows: better hunting from a distance (flint-tipped arrows once stone can be cut).

innovations.name: Stone Cutting
innovations.description: Knapping flint and shaping stone: stone hand axes and knives, flint spears and flint-tipped arrows.

innovations.name: Camp Defense
innovations.description: Standing guard and driving off threats. Opens the Warrior (who needs a spear to patrol).

innovations.name: Traditional Sites
innovations.description: Established places the group returns to.

innovations.name: Forest Gardening
innovations.description: Staying in one area long enough to tend a small garden.

innovations.name: Sustenance Gardening
innovations.description: Permanently settled and growing only enough food to survive. Opens the Sustenance Gardener.

innovations.name: Forestry
innovations.description: Organized harvesting of timber.

innovations.name: Spirituality
innovations.description: Finding existential meaning in abstract form.

innovations.name: Rituals
innovations.description: Performing symbolic gestures to invoke mystery and power.

innovations.name: Burial Rites
innovations.description: Honoring the dead and giving meaning to lives lost.

innovations.name: Ritual Dance & Spirit Journeys
innovations.description: Performing symbolic acts to seek spiritual insight.

innovations.name: Ceremonies
innovations.description: Organized rituals for communal worship.

innovations.name: Sacred Sites
innovations.description: Places set apart for worship.

innovations.name: Annual Traditions
innovations.description: The beginning of regular group gatherings.

innovations.name: Ceremonial Feasting
innovations.description: Brings the whole group together.

innovations.name: Tribal Council
innovations.description: A group representing community interests.

innovations.name: Public Assemblies
innovations.description: Gatherings where everyone has a say.
